title: O My Soul Arise
lyrics_original: Before the throne my surety stands,
Before the throne my surety stands.
My name is written on His hands.
His blood atoned for every race,
His blood atoned for every race.
And sprinkles now the Throne of Grace.
God owns you as His child!
His Spirit answers to the blood,
His Spirit answers to the blood,
And tells me I am born of God.
God owns you as His child!
He owns me as His child;
With confidence I now draw nigh.
With confidence I now draw nigh,
God owns you as His child!

bible_verses.english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing he always lives to make intercession for them.
Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for standing before the Father on my behalf today. When my heart is weighed down by guilt, remind me that my name is permanently engraved upon Your hands. Thank You that Your love intercedes for me constantly and Your grace has set me free. Help me to step out of fear and live in the quiet confidence of Your complete redemption. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When guilt and fear whisper that we are unworthy, this song points our eyes upward to the heavenly throne room. Jesus stands before God not as a harsh judge, but as our loving Advocate who holds us eternally secure. His wounded hands bear our very names, declaring that His sacrifice is completely sufficient for our redemption. Today, you can shake off every lingering shame and rest peacefully in the intercession of your living Savior.
